g.text: The replacement verdict depends on the miss penalty
Against the supplied projection: YOLO26n has 58 fewer false positives and 21 more misses than YOLO11n.
Nominal strict improvement requires miss/false-positive penalty < 58/21 ≈ 2.7619. Equality excludes it.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #404854

g.text: Dashed line: equal penalties. Markers: exact boundary outcomes. Declared stress sets on the same 64 exposed images.
